create_behavior_parameters: create a BehaviorParameters namedtuple with stance duration, forward speed, turning speed, standing height, and incline angle
convert_motor_angles_to_leg_pose: convert raw motor angles into leg swing and extension pose values using motor_angles_to_leg_pose
